text: The 2.1.9 change of M02 UI › Sloty (66se825m) adds: "New page i New folder tworzą wpis w poddrzewie akordeonu, w którym je wywołano" to the context menu of the page trees (Rename, Delete, New page, New folder). The code's tree has no such menu entries at all: a file row's menu offers Rename only (the move), there is no Delete / New page / New folder per row or per folder, and the only creation affordance is the `+` beside the PAGES header, which creates in the base root. This window did not add the missing entries; the accordion slot now cuts subtrees (so a later New page/New folder can take the accordion's `rootId` + `path` as its parent), but nothing to scope exists yet. Either the menu is a later unit's work or the section describes more than the product has.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0802 — the file-row menu stays Rename-only; no New page / New folder entries exist in the tree yet to be scoped to the accordion's subtree.
